title: 2026-10-22 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：KPage: Cross-Block Page Compaction for Hardware-Efficient Sparse Attention (KlingAI Research, 裸前向 kernel 几何均值 1.77x，部分占据的三维布局上 2.29x。)、Cache Engineering for Agents (The Chinese University of Hong Kong, 滚动丢弃策略 +1.7 分准确率、-27.7% 成本，AKV 引擎 1.5x P95 加速。)、MLIPS: Multi-Layer Indexer Pool Sharing (NVIDIA Corporation, 1.14-1.40x 加速、能耗 -14.8%~27.4%、准确率变化在 -1.49~+0.29pp。)、The Token-Energy Law of LLM Decode: Active Bytes and Realized Time Account for Joules per Token (NVIDIA Corporation, 两个字节坐标加时间即可预测每 token 能耗，留出条件平均误差 ≤3.73%。)
